notes.title: TANK ZERO v1.1 Update
Demo version available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297219/089f30b5f4999f411259e149f2c29fb7cbef35b9.jpg
We are pleased to announce that we have finished the demo version of the game! It has some limitations, unlike the full version. But anyway it will allow you to fully enjoy the game and decide whether you need the full version of the game or not.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346880/TANK_ZERO_Demo/
